title: Lantern Astronaut on Floating Isle
description: An astronaut in a golden scaled suit with glowing turquoise accents floats above a rocky, tiered floating island. The astronaut holds an illuminated vintage lantern in one hand while standing against a dramatic, cloudy sky filled with aurora-like purple and green light.
prompt: A lone astronaut wearing a golden scaled spacesuit with glowing turquoise crystals stands on a jagged floating rock island with visible roots and terraced patterns. The astronaut holds an old-fashioned metal lantern emitting bright light. The helmet visor reflects a swirling galaxy. Dramatic purple and orange clouds with green aurora glow fill the sky. Smaller floating rock fragments drift nearby in a dreamy, surreal atmosphere.
